name: Excellent Women
overview: Psychic Wu Yue joins forces with a policewoman, a forensic examiner, and a sketch artist to investigate a string of shocking cases, from fake resurrections to serial murders. As their all-female team digs deeper, Wu Yue crosses paths with wealthy heir Ji Wenxuan, whose carefully hidden secret draws them into a dangerous family conspiracy. With the truth slowly surfacing, the women must confront not only cunning killers, but the darker side of human desire and revenge itself.
